🎯 Attempting to open metric: OTIF (On-Time In-Full)

✅ Successfully opened metric: OTIF (On-Time In-Full) using strategy 1 (2 indicators verified, URL changed: true)
🔍 Verifying correct metric opened: OTIF (On-Time In-Full)
✅ Confirmed correct metric opened: OTIF (On-Time In-Full) (2/4 verifications passed, URL match: true)
✅ Successfully opened OTIF metric detail view

🔍 Verifying results content: •The overall OTIF (On-Time In-Full) performance for the analyzed period (July 28, 2025, to January 28, 2026) is mixed, with some orders being on time and in full while others are not meeting both criteria.•The fill rates for the shipped orders range from 92.31% to 97.75%, indicating a decent level of order fulfillment accuracy across different customers and regions.•A significant number of orders are not delivered on time, as indicated by the "is_on_time" field being false for multiple entries, suggesting potential delays in the supply chain or logistics.•The order quantities vary widely, from 13 units to 711 units, highlighting the diverse needs of different customers and the importance of accurate fulfillment to meet these varying demands.•One customer, Joseph-Lee, stands out for consistently achieving high OTIF performance with a fill rate of 97.3%, indicating a strong track record in timely and complete order deliveries.▴
